- Cloud & DevOps: AWS (DynamoDB, SQS, Secrets Manager, S3, IAM), Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery, Cloud Storage), Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins DinD, Unleash Feature Flags, Linux Kernel Inodes (inotify).

## Quantified Production Highlights
- Sub-50ms Synchronous POS Fraud Engine: Built from scratch in Golang utilizing the Strategy Pattern to detect cashier collusion and rolling-window velocity anomalies with cross-timezone normalization.
- 100% OLTP/OLAP Decoupling: Integrated native `gosnowflake` drivers into Go microservices, streaming and aggregating millions of transactional events into merchant dashboards without database read locks.
- 4.8x Cryptographic Hashing Throughput: Accelerated SHA-256 computation over high-volume data streams implementing low-level SIMD AVX2 vector instructions in Assembly/Go.
- Zero-Polling Kernel File Observability: Intercepted Linux kernel inodes (`inotify`) to trigger real-time cryptographic state notarizations with zero user-space CPU polling overhead.
- Enterprise Security & Compliance Automation: Automated access governance and secret detection across 10+ core repositories correlating BigQuery telemetry, internal APIs, and pre-commit hooks under SOC 2 / Vanta standards.

## Verified Career History
- Senior Backend Engineer @ LATAM Airlines (Oct 2026 - Present): Leading airline holding company in Latin America, engineering mission-critical airline platforms, high-concurrency booking, and global flight operations with Go, Distributed Systems, AWS, Kubernetes, and Clean Architecture.
- Senior Software Engineer - Core Platform & Security @ Leal (Sep 2025 - Jun 2026): Engineered real-time Go anti-fraud engines, Clean Architecture microservices on DynamoDB/Redis, centralized TOTP platform, Snowflake analytics pipelines, and SOC 2 container hardening.
- Senior Backend Security Engineer @ Mercado Libre (Aug 2024 - Sep 2025): Deployed internal risk evaluation engines in Go/Python, automated secret scanning across Git histories/GCP buckets, enforced shift-left pre-commit controls, and orchestrated incident triage via n8n.
- Software Engineer - Identity & Trust Platforms @ Imagemaker (Dec 2023 - Aug 2024): Architected digital identity verification microservices in Go and PostgreSQL for SOVOS Trust-Services, biometric facial validation, OAuth2 protocols, and dynamic OTP engines.
- Co-Founder & Principal Engineer @ FYLD, Inc. (May 2019 - Sep 2023): Designed enterprise data witnessing platform in Go/gRPC, Bitcoin/UTXO state-anchoring, Merkle tree proofs, SIMD SHA-256 acceleration, and kernel inode monitoring.
- Backend Software Engineer @ Cobuild Lab (Nov 2018 - Jun 2019): Built concurrent work queue coordinators, streaming GZIP/XML parsing CLI tools, and Gin REST microservices with Auth0.
- Earlier Engineering Milestones: PlazaETC (AWS/MySQL Multi-Vendor Backend), 4Geeks Academy (Echo/Aerospike Referral APIs), E.T.C.R Rómulo Gallegos (Go/GraphQL Institutional Admissions).
